limitations: These checks establish the exact stored source edition and its loading integrity; they do not confer scholarly, santhiya or human source approval.
The reader trust anchors are delivered by the app HTML and verifier. This is not a defense against replacement of the entire application or arbitrary prior same-origin JavaScript.
canonicalization: See evidence/source-integrity-baseline.json and module header. Full metadata and original text are included; array order is preserved; no Unicode normalization.
